description: This file defines classes and structures related to managing Triton kernels in the PyTorch Native Runtime, including kernel parameters, launch configurations, and a registry for kernel managers.

classes.name: GridDims
classes.description: Represents the dimensions of a grid with x, y, z axes.

classes.name: KernelInputParams
classes.description: Holds kernel parameter names, types, and output indices for backend-specific initialization.

classes.name: LaunchParams
classes.description: Base class for kernel launch parameters, including grid dimensions and attribute parsing.

classes.name: KernelInputs
classes.description: Manages kernel input arguments and attributes, allowing addition of tensor and other arguments.

classes.name: TritonKernelManager
classes.description: Manages Triton kernel lifecycle, including creation of inputs, launch parameters, and execution.

methods.name: set_from_variant
methods.description: Template helper to extract and assign a value from an Attribute to a target variable, with optional validation.

methods.name: parseCommonAttributes
methods.description: Parses common attributes such as grid dimensions from a node.

methods.name: create_inputs
methods.description: Creates kernel input objects with specified number of arguments and attributes.

methods.name: createLaunchParams
methods.description: Creates and parses launch parameters from a node, target-specific in subclasses.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Executes the kernel with given launch parameters and arguments.
